children: The Atlanta Braves option in the Polymarket submarket for the Cincinnati Reds vs. Atlanta Braves game saw a sharp drop in its implied win probability for the -1.5 spread, falling from 40.5% one hour earlier to 20.5%. According to ChainCatcher, the move reflected a 20 percentage point swing and may have been affected by breaking news.

title: Atlanta Braves Spread Odds Swing Sharply on Polymarket
